findings.message: Rule-bearing legacy code in Subscriptions.Rules.paymentGrace matches no observation and has rule-bearing constructs without accepted authority (ast analyzer). Superseded authority: numeric literal 7 (line 20): value 7 = DEC-SB01.p1 (superseded by DEC-SB05, value only) and no accepted parameter. The code still carries a superseded decision's value. Question for Revenue Operations: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.

Rule-bearing legacy code in Subscriptions.Rules.isSuspended matches no observation and has rule-bearing constructs without accepted authority (ast analyzer). No accepted authority: wildcard default returning false for unlisted cases (line 27): no value to match. A wildcard default silently decides every unlisted case; no record authorizes that default. Question for praxis-intake: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.
